انفضحا (form VII)
# اِنْفَضَحَا (infaḍaḥā) /in.fa.dˤa.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# اِنْفَضِحَا (infaḍiḥā) /in.fa.dˤi.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
